download_source: GEO FTP samples + series suppl; TISCH2 static
notes: Zhang et al. 2021 PNAS. 7 ccRCC + 1 chRCC (SS_2016, excluded) + 6 benign adjacent samples from 5 donors. Author cell annotations on GEO. TISCH2 Sample/Tissue columns are swapped within 4 tumour-normal pairs: cells are joined on the GSM prefix, never on TISCH2 Sample.
GEO describes right and left ccRCC homogenates (bilateral disease). TISCH2 Patient reads 'patient 1,2,3', so donor identity is not established; treated as one donor pending the publication.

Neal et al. 2018 Cell (organoid study). Only fresh-tumour expression libraries (ft_gex rep1/rep2) are used; organoid, PBMC and V(D)J libraries are excluded. rep1/rep2 are replicate libraries of one tumour and are summed to donor. TISCH2 labels contain no malignant cells.

download_source: GEO FTP samples + series suppl; TISCH2 static
notes: Wu et al. 2020 Nature multi-cancer T-cell study. Renal samples only: RT tumour, RN adjacent normal, RB blood. TISCH2 labels contain no malignant cells.
Borcherding et al. 2021. Tumour-infiltrating immune cells (T) and PBMC (P). TISCH2 table holds 25,681 cells, not 33,441, and labels PBMC samples Tissue=Normal. No malignant cells.
Yuen et al. 2020 Nat Med. Only Tumor1-4 and Blood1-4 (RCC) are used; R/NR samples are bladder-cancer PBMC and excluded. Never pooled with untreated primary data. No malignant cells in TISCH2 labels.

Li R et al. 2022 Cancer Cell (Sanger). 10 ccRCC + 1 oncocytoma + 1 benign cyst; multiple tumour regions, tumour-normal interface, normal kidney. Non-ccRCC donors excluded; regions summed to donor. Not in TISCH2.

download_source: GEO FTP series (RAW.tar + author Seurat object)
notes: Massenet-Regad et al. 2023 iScience. 3 donors (p022, p027, p029), each with tumour and juxtatumoral (adjacent normal) tissue. Deposited matrices are unfiltered barcodes; cells, labels (Celltype_Harmony) and doublet calls (ManDblt) come from the author Seurat object. Cell-name suffixes _1.._6 are mapped to samples through orig.ident and checked to be one-to-one.
Davidson et al. 2023 Cancer Res. N1 pools 3 donors (unusable donor identity); N2 is patient 4. No author cell annotation on GEO. Not required for this analysis.
Zvirblyte et al. 2024 Commun Biol. Different platform; STARsolo multimapper mode means integer counts are unverified; annotated cells only in a 5 GB h5ad. Not required for this analysis.

Yu Z et al. 2023 Cancer Res. 19 total-tumour homogenates, one per donor; no normal kidney. No author cell annotation is deposited: cells are labelled by SingleR against GSE159115 author labels using protein-coding genes only (config reference_annotation), so no lncRNA influences the malignant call. Malignant vs microenvironment contrasts only.
